title: Wso2am: Apache ZooKeeper quorum TLS fails to enforce peer hostname verification in FIPS-mode deployments…
description: A security vulnerability in the wso2am package affects Apache ZooKeeper quorum TLS in FIPS-mode deployments by failing to enforce peer hostname verification. This flaw could allow an attacker to bypass hostname verification during TLS communication within the quorum. The issue is addressed in versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4.
